description: 外部待验证项关闭工作队列契约。该 gate 消费 external validation closure plan，把 occurrence 按 owner/category 聚合为可分派 work item，并补齐 assignee、proofRef、lastCheckedAt、staleReason 与 closeConditionResult；不连接真实外部系统，不把 pending live 写成 passed。

workQueuePolicy.shipGate: 只要 workItems 数量大于 0，shipGate.status 必须为 blocked。生成 work queue 不代表任何外部 live validation 已关闭。
workQueuePolicy.closeCondition: work item 只有在 proofRef 指向脱敏真实外部证据、且 closeConditionResult 由后续 proof verifier 判定 passed 后才可关闭。

privacyBoundary: 输出只允许保存 owner、category、凭证依赖类型、复核命令模板、关闭条件、路径、行号和 source hash；不得保存真实 token、secret、DSN、私钥、生产日志正文、用户报告正文、外部账号数据或 pending excerpt 正文。
nonClaims: Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not replace third-party audit review.
Does not authorize production credential use.
Does not close production API/HF/Bot/OIDC/SIEM/OTel/Vault/KMS/Postgres/webhook validations without separate real evidence.
Does not evaluate proofRef until a separate proof verifier is implemented.
